constraints.name: risk_reviews_check1
constraints.definition:
CHECK (((review_status <> ALL (ARRAY['CLEARED'::text, 'CONFIRMED_RISK'::text, 'ESCALATED'::text])) OR ((reviewed_by IS NOT NULL) AND (reviewed_at IS NOT NULL) AND
CASE review_status
    WHEN 'CLEARED'::text THEN (resolution_code = 'VALID_ACTIVITY'::text)
    WHEN 'CONFIRMED_RISK'::text THEN (resolution_code = 'CONFIRMED_SUSPICIOUS'::text)
    ELSE (resolution_code = 'SPECIALIST_REVIEW'::text)
END AND (resolution_code IS NOT NULL))))

views.name: batch_reconciliation
views.definition:
WITH counts AS (
         SELECT b.batch_id,
            b.rows_received,
            b.publication_complete,
            b.file_failure_code,
            count(r.source_row) AS recorded,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE (r.disposition = 'ACCEPTED'::text)) AS accepted,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE (r.disposition = 'QUARANTINED'::text)) AS quarantined,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE (r.disposition = 'DUPLICATE'::text)) AS duplicate,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE (r.disposition = 'FAILED_TECHNICAL'::text)) AS failed_technical
           FROM (ingestion_batches b
             LEFT JOIN ingestion_records r USING (batch_id))
          GROUP BY b.batch_id
        ), reconciled AS (
         SELECT counts.batch_id,
            counts.rows_received,
            counts.publication_complete,
            counts.file_failure_code,
            counts.recorded,
            counts.accepted,
            counts.quarantined,
            counts.duplicate,
            counts.failed_technical,
            ((((counts.rows_received - counts.accepted) - counts.quarantined) - counts.duplicate) - counts.failed_technical) AS pending,
            ((counts.rows_received IS NOT NULL) AND (counts.recorded <= counts.rows_received)) AS counts_consistent
           FROM counts
        )
 SELECT batch_id,
    rows_received,
    publication_complete,
    file_failure_code,
    recorded,
    accepted,
    quarantined,
    duplicate,
    failed_technical,
    pending,
    counts_consistent,
        CASE
            WHEN (NOT counts_consistent) THEN
            CASE
                WHEN (file_failure_code IS NOT NULL) THEN 'FAILED'::text
                ELSE 'RECEIVED'::text
            END
            WHEN ((file_failure_code IS NOT NULL) OR (failed_technical > 0)) THEN
            CASE
                WHEN (((accepted + quarantined) + duplicate) > 0) THEN 'PARTIAL'::text
                ELSE 'FAILED'::text
            END
            WHEN (pending > 0) THEN
            CASE
                WHEN publication_complete THEN 'QUEUED'::text
                ELSE 'PROCESSING'::text
            END
            ELSE 'COMPLETED'::text
        END AS status
   FROM reconciled;

views.name: quarantine_workflow
views.definition:
SELECT q.quarantine_id,
    q.batch_id,
    q.source_row,
    q.reason_code,
    q.reason_detail,
    q.validation_errors,
    q.candidate_account_id,
    q.safe_payload_key,
    q.safe_payload_version,
    q.source_reference,
    q.quarantined_at,
    c.correction_id,
    r.canonical_tx_id,
        CASE
            WHEN (c.correction_id IS NULL) THEN 'OPEN'::text
            WHEN (c.action = 'REJECT'::text) THEN 'REJECTED'::text
            WHEN (r.disposition = ANY (ARRAY['ACCEPTED'::text, 'DUPLICATE'::text])) THEN 'RESOLVED'::text
            WHEN (r.disposition = 'QUARANTINED'::text) THEN 'OPEN'::text
            ELSE 'RESUBMITTED'::text
        END AS workflow_status
   FROM ((quarantine_cases q
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT c_1.correction_id,
            c_1.quarantine_id,
            c_1.request_id,
            c_1.request_digest,
            c_1.correction_version,
            c_1.submitted_by,
            c_1.submitted_at,
            c_1.correction_notes,
            c_1.corrected_payload_key,
            c_1.corrected_payload_version,
            c_1.action,
            c_1.reprocess_batch_id,
            c_1.reprocess_source_row
           FROM quarantine_corrections c_1
          WHERE (c_1.quarantine_id = q.quarantine_id)
          ORDER BY c_1.correction_version DESC
         LIMIT 1) c ON (true))
     LEFT JOIN ingestion_records r ON (((r.batch_id = c.reprocess_batch_id) AND (r.source_row = c.reprocess_source_row))));

provenance.scope: Submitted base schema and migrations 001 through 006, reconstructed without customer data
provenance.catalog_validation: Isolated PostgreSQL 18. Retained PostgreSQL 16 workflow column contract compared separately.

notes: transactions.batch_id is lineage, not a declared foreign key.
candidate_account_id and subject names are not SQL foreign keys.
Cognito holds application identities. DynamoDB holds current cloud alert claims.
alerts is the retained relational legacy/direct-path table.
batch_reconciliation and quarantine_workflow are derived views, not tables.
Frozen JSON assessments and outboxes intentionally preserve audit and recovery state.
